scope: Independent-context semantic/method assessment of the two retained first worlds and their sole prospectively triggered fresh read-only successor. No reviewer model sampling, repository/source edits, publication or real learner work.
bottom_line: For this one policy-conditioned fictional scenario, a fresh consumer autonomously acquired the unreferenced neutral hint report, applied and verified a justified scoped Knowledge withdrawal, and a fresh read-only successor recovered that resulting state and preserved its limits. The unchanged-report-absent world continued safely without persistence. This supports the bounded conjunction; wider Core #34 acceptance remains partial/open.

assessment_basis.semantic_review: Read the concrete learner-facing first responses, actual request/result documents, full submitted Knowledge payload, original Evidence/report, pre/post states and successor input/origin. The mechanical summary was not used as a substitute for these artifacts.
assessment_basis.independent_verification: 56 independent checks passed. Re-executed all 11 original raw requests through unchanged actual host/fake-provider code, including result values, complete provider traces and resulting states. All three retained replay files match independently.
assessment_basis.integrity: All 70 prospective freeze bindings, 221 source bindings and 26 original prospective-review bindings remain byte-identical. The frozen plan is exactly reviewed candidate 3. No receipt-integrity errors, failed consumer operations or transport rejections occurred.
assessment_basis.independence_limit: Same-family separate native review context; independent model/provider diversity is not established. Retained first-output and no-resampling status is supported by controller records and sealed artifacts, not an independent provider generation audit.

first_world_assessments.actual_acquisition: Three successful calls: required Progress with optional Definition/Plan; discovery; then actual content read of the Knowledge owner returned by discovery. Obtained Progress, one performance Evidence record and current Knowledge. Optional Definition/Plan absence was not generalized into absent Evidence or a need to restart.
first_world_assessments.teaching_content: The bank/river versus bank/paycheck example fixes the final vocabulary token, then asks whether its ID alone could distinguish next-word continuations and what prefix information a contextual representation needs. This is a relevant conceptual application under provisional explanation support. It does not claim mastery, turn route completion into capability mastery, or fabricate an answer.
first_world_assessments.claim_and_coverage_limits: The basis accurately attributes provisional explanation and naming to the one observed performance. It describes discovery coverage as the bound snapshot and does not claim no report globally or infer a broader portfolio.
first_world_assessments.durable_decision: No owning write was attempted; full provider state is unchanged. The response does not claim any invented durable update.
first_world_assessments.successor_decision: Independently recomputed no_new_payload. No baseline successor was warranted or created.

first_world_assessments.actual_acquisition: Five successful calls: optional route documents (Progress obtained); discovery; discovered Knowledge owner content read; reconciliation; post-write Knowledge readback. Discovery actually returned both original performance and the neutral report before the Knowledge decision. The Knowledge locator came from discovery rather than an assumed Topic=Domain mapping.
first_world_assessments.report_interpretation: The original record only appeared unassisted. The concrete later self-report attributes the explanation to a hint but says the names were recalled independently and no later attempt occurred. The consumer uses it as reinterpretive context, not a new performance or negative capability evidence.
first_world_assessments.actual_write: Receipt 004 submits complete Knowledge revision 3 using the token actually returned by receipt 003. The exact capability-object delta removes explanation and retains label_recall byte-value-equivalent after YAML parsing, including provisional state, medium confidence, sole original support reference and basis. Top-level revision advances and updated_at is added. No neutral report is inserted into support/challenge, and no unsupported/conflicted/misconception state is invented.
first_world_assessments.readback_and_preservation: The host returns ok/applied true. Receipt 005 returns the exact submitted Knowledge content. Only learner/knowledge/synthetic.yaml changes. Both Evidence records, Progress, milestone/watch/checkpoint and every other document remain unchanged. One original task_response occurrence remains.
first_world_assessments.teaching_content: The deposited-cash versus watched-ducks prefixes illustrate the same-token distinction. The response defines a vector as a list of numbers, gives the vocabulary-entry-to-contextual-representation bridge, and explicitly treats model internals as a black box. It gives proportionate instruction without automatically testing uncertainty or assuming inability. The new explanatory text is teaching, not a claimed learner performance.
first_world_assessments.successor_decision: The frozen payload projection differs because the relevant explanation claim is absent, corroborated by applied owning receipt 004. Receipt/state-chain integrity is complete. Exactly one successor is prospectively required; this is substantive correction rather than merely a timestamp or wording trigger.

successor_assessment.input_and_authority: Initial provider-state bytes exactly equal report-world sealed final-state bytes. Packet bytes equal the pre-output read-only packet template; the task equals the frozen template with only opaque-handle substitution. The origin binds the parent seal, final state and exact successor inputs. No parent reply, summary or receipt is in the semantic input. Writable roots are empty.
successor_assessment.actual_acquisition: Three successful chosen reads obtain Progress, both original Evidence/report records and current Knowledge revision 3. Discovery shows original explanation support no longer referenced while naming remains referenced; the consumer then separately reads actual Knowledge content.
successor_assessment.semantic_content: The response explicitly recognizes absent explanation as unknown, not inability, while retaining scoped provisional naming. Its same-token bank comparison explains contextual processing and the consequence for next-token predictions. It does not claim recovered independent explanatory mastery, another learner attempt, or a repaired capability.
successor_assessment.persistence_and_state: No write is attempted or claimed. Full state and Evidence remain unchanged, with one original performance occurrence. The read-only successor does not recursively trigger another model.
successor_assessment.causal_limit: The successor also rereads the original report and Evidence. The observed result is safe recovery/use of the corrected state together with preserved source context; it does not establish that changed Knowledge was causally necessary or that the successor could not independently reinterpret the source report.

frozen_criterion_results.self_selected_actual_acquisition: Supported for these trajectories; all choose valid reads without a supplied concrete Evidence ID, Knowledge owner, gold path list or mandatory read order.
frozen_criterion_results.unknown_versus_absence: Preserved. Missing optional planning documents and bounded discovery scope are accurately reported. Removal of the independent explanation claim is not encoded as unsupported.
frozen_criterion_results.claim_specific_correction: Supported. The report affects explanation while naming remains unchanged.
frozen_criterion_results.no_new_performance: Preserved across all three trajectories. No added Evidence, duplicate scoring, fictional learner answer or second failure appears.
frozen_criterion_results.optional_persistence: Preserved in conduct and scoring. Baseline is accepted without a write; report voluntarily makes a justified owning update. No outcome was rejected merely for failing to persist.
frozen_criterion_results.teaching_action_flexibility: Preserved. The baseline asks an application question; report and successor give conceptual explanations. These concrete differences are compatible with the records but are not required labels or evidence of an identified causal treatment effect.
frozen_criterion_results.objective_successor_selection: Satisfied. Baseline has no final payload delta; report has a genuine final claim removal and an applied owning write. Exactly that one fresh read-only successor is run.
frozen_criterion_results.mechanical_replay: All 11 raw first requests reproduce exact result values, provider traces and final states; mechanical admission is evaluated separately from the semantic findings above.

method_and_provenance_qualifications: The freeze precedes every recorded consumer host call. The two initial semantic packets are byte-identical; one first trajectory was retained for each coherent world, followed by one conditional successor. This is three context trajectories, not three independent performances or a population sample.

dispatch-input-qualification.json reports that submitted native task text omitted the task file trailing LF. The declared reconstruction hashes match exactly the task-file bytes minus that LF. This is a disclosed literal dispatch-byte difference, with no substantive task-text change shown; exact frozen task-file bytes must not be labeled exact backend generation input bytes.

The LF qualification was recorded after dispatch. This reviewer verifies the declared file-to-reconstruction relationship, not unseen tool argument bytes, complete provider prompts/build/seed or generation-time attestation.

The bridge grants only the existing target Knowledge and Progress writes to first consumers and read-only access to the successor. Product operations, schemas, protocols and source remain unchanged. Evidence creation was confined to fictional preparation.
Prior preparation and operator-preflight failures remain retained. They are not consumer failures and are not hidden by the eleven successful actual consumer calls.

Fake provider head/blob tokens are reused. The report write token equals the actual prior read token, but this does not prove real Git freshness or production concurrency. Source labels bind the 221 inspected working files rather than falsely equating the local synthetic HEAD with canonical main.

Instructional separation in a shared filesystem and operation receipts do not prove hard sandboxing or full native tool history. The first-response/no-resampling claims retain the disclosed controller-provenance limits.

cost_and_scope_accounting.interpretation: Visible-result byte counts use the actual bridge JSON encoding. Provider trace entries include backend validation/materialization. Neither quantity is a token count, model-cost measure or necessary-minimum retrieval claim.

actionable_conclusion.smallest_observed_deficiency: No behavioral or interface deficiency is exposed within this bounded scenario. The known dispatch-file-versus-message-byte qualification remains documentary and must remain visible.
actionable_conclusion.product_action: Existing bounded reads and owning reconciliation suffice for this observed acquisition/correction/fresh-readback conjunction. No new selector, schema, protocol, automatic downgrade or diagnostic trigger is justified by these data.
actionable_conclusion.stop: The declared two first worlds, sole objectively triggered successor, independent semantic review and exact replay are complete. Do not add arms or resample to strengthen the result under this task.
actionable_conclusion.remaining_obligations: Reliability, causal isolation, broader/noisy or incomplete portfolios, cross-topic/legacy discovery, real-provider recovery, learner benefit, prior partial/failure cases and product acceptance remain unresolved. Publication and any broader study require their separately authorized scope.
